quarterly_data.quarter: ASMPT HKEX announcement: 2026 Unaudited Interim Results for the Six Months Ended 30 (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 and H1 2026 figures (interim results announcement, continuing operations): Q2 revenue HK$4,935.8 million (US$630.0 million, +52.1% YoY) and bookings HK$7,080.4 million (US$903.6 million); SEMI Q2 revenue HK$2.89 billion (US$369.1 million, +56.1% YoY), bookings US$428.1 million, adjusted gross margin 46.5%; SMT Q2 revenue HK$2.04 billion (US$260.9 million) and record bookings HK$3.73 billion (US$475.4 million), gross margin 36.8%. H1 revenue HK$8.90 billion (US$1.14 billion) and bookings HK$12.75 billion (US$1.63 billion). Advanced packaging posted record half-year revenue of US$339.0 million (+17%, 30% of Group revenue); SEMI pluggable optical transceiver solutions revenue almost tripled to approximately US$75 million. H1 revenue from China 42.2%; Taiwan HK$1,095,540 thousand (HK$530,294 thousand), Malaysia HK$867,947 thousand (HK$296,342 thousand), Korea HK$313,942 thousand (HK$877,338 thousand); top five customers about 19% of revenue. Advance payments from customers HK$1,953,064 thousand (HK$1,092,195 thousand at end-2025); net cash HK$3.63 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 revenue US$630.0 million (+52.1%); Q2 bookings US$903.6 million; H1 advanced packaging revenue US$339.0 million

quarterly_data.quarter: ASMPT HKEX announcement: 2026 Unaudited Interim Results for the Six Months Ended 30 (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging updates beyond the call (interim results announcement): ASMPT shipped its newly developed chip-on-panel TCB tool for quarter panel to the leading advanced logic customer for qualification and is collaborating with leading industry players on packaging solutions for both embedded and surface silicon bridges; its hybrid bonding collaboration with key logic and memory customers has moved to the sampling stage; in memory the timing of customers' new tool purchases remains dependent on HBM4 product rollout schedules. SEMI mainstream growth came from high utilisation at leading IDMs on power management demand for AI data centres, with China wire and die bonder demand supported by AI infrastructure expansion.

quarterly_data.quarter: ASMPT HKEX announcement: 2026 Unaudited Interim Results for the Six Months Ended 30 (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Divestments completed (interim results announcement): the disposal of ASMPT NEXX closed on 3 June 2026, after which NEXX ceased to be a subsidiary and is no longer consolidated; the divestment of Semiconductor Wet Advanced Technology (SWAT), a non-wholly owned PRC subsidiary, through share cancellation completed on 26 June 2026, after which SWAT ceased to be a subsidiary.
